claycode.delta: Published G9 grammar is not self-consistent with current G9 V3 surface: comparison operators and if-blocks used by the moving-stack spec are absent. Add a machine-executable grammar self-parse/roundtrip gate before semantic freeze; do not redesign semantics for the tested loop contract.
claycode.next_test: Production parser must self-parse complete G9 V3 and canonical-roundtrip it with explicit operator precedence/associativity.

frank.delta: Loop-of-loops remains UNRESOLVED scientifically. ClayCode can provision generic loop dynamics instrumentation without asserting the ontology; no need to wait for ontology promotion.
frank.next_test: Ubuntu H1 matched event-driven vs loop-dynamics instrumentation with fixed/adaptive recurrence, lesion/rescue and cost shadows.

harness.delta: H-WP-03/H2 should require ClayCode grammar self-conformance and roundtrip before adapter integration; current parser gap would otherwise contaminate differential failures.
harness.next_test: Use the frozen parser on one real H1 subsystem before H2 architecture translation.

claygraph.delta: Current typed hyperrelation/projection receipts are sufficient for loop topology references in the tested contract. Keep graph activation and selection separate from truth/authority.
claygraph.next_test: Attach loop readout IDs and intervention handles to dynamic H1 graph deltas once executable H1 traces exist.

unifieddb.delta: Current epoch/revision/receipt substrate is sufficient at this research level for loop readout persistence. No physical-store consolidation implication was found.
unifieddb.next_test: Define replay query contract only after H1 generates actual loop-series access patterns.

gwt.delta: Preserve GWT selection/use/outcome/re-entry measurements as distinct from loop stability. Generic loop readouts can cross-reference WorkspaceEpisode epochs without adding a GWT scalar.
gwt.next_test: Adaptive recurrence routing vs fixed recurrence budget under matched episodes.

hyperposition.delta: Existing alternatives/higher-order relation/timescale semantics map to the tested loop contract; no new Hyperposition-driven ClayCode primitive was justified.
hyperposition.next_test: Later test branch reopening as anti-stagnation mechanism on stalled H1 episodes.

emergenz.delta: Loop recurrence/stability instrumentation is admissible evidence input but not emergence evidence by itself.
emergenz.next_test: Use loop readouts inside lesion/rescue, truthful-vs-shuffled re-entry and macro/pairwise controls.

clayresearch.delta: BASE critical path should prioritize grammar self-conformance -> typed IR -> effect checking -> evaluator/lowering before additional ClayCode semantic expansion. MLIR/Tree-sitter/WIT analogues support this separation of IR, canonicalization, parsing and ABI resources.
clayresearch.next_test: Recompute BASE work order with grammar self-parse as a prerequisite of CC-WP-02/03 rather than a new semantic branch.

shared_ancestry_note: FRANK loop-of-loops branch repetition is one ancestry family; only the new parser experiment is independent execution evidence for representability/grammar behavior.
